analyst.summary: Campus Activewear, India's leading sports-and-athleisure footwear brand, continues to grow at a healthy double-digit clip (FY26 sales +11.4%, profit +24%) with strong returns on capital and improving working-capital discipline. The stock's valuation is rich relative to that growth rate, which is the main reason for caution, but we see no underlying business deterioration. We rate it a Hold.
